```{r}
library(writexl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(here); i_am("code/make_supp_table.Rmd")
```


```{r}
metadata = read.delim(here("data/Supp_tab_metadata.txt"))
metadata = mutate(metadata, Sheet = if_else(Sheet == "", gsub("\\..*", "", basename(File)), Sheet))
head(metadata)
```

```{r figures}
figs = list(metadata=metadata)
for (panel in 1:nrow(metadata)){
  tab = read.delim(here(metadata$File[panel]))
  figs[[metadata$Sheet[panel]]] = tab
  #print(head(tab))
}
names(figs)
```


```{r write_supp_table}
write_xlsx(figs, here("output/Supplementary_data.xlsx"))
```
